title: Probability of matching a finite family
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $D$ be a finite set of indices, and let $e$ assign to each index a Boolean function on $
$ Boolean inputs. Choose a Boolean function uniformly from all such functions. The probability that the chosen function equals $e(d)$ for at least one $d\in D$ is at most $|D|/2^{2^n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is a finite set of indices
$e$ assigns a Boolean function on $n$ inputs to each index
